scope.purpose: Prepare runnable contracts for a small active-site encoder architecture sweep after the active-site feature spec and target-granularity gate freeze.

active_site_encoder_feature_spec_report.role: human-readable feature spec and readiness report

active_site_encoder_feature_spec_artifac.role: frozen v0 active-site feature spec and cheap local cache manifest

sequence_nn_label_manifest.role: current702 row manifest and Wave 1 split assignment source

eval_contract.role: OOS, diversity, support, abstention, canary, and pooling policy

split_assignment.role: repaired Wave 1 in-distribution versus heldout partition

foldseek_coordinate_readiness.role: selected structure and local coordinate materialization status

wave1_1_diagnostic_result.role: review-only Wave 1.1 diagnostic cells and method result shape

wave1_representation_result_card_addendu.role: current702 addendum for Wave 1 representation result interpretation

v2_sublabel_audit.role: proposal-only v2 auxiliary target source; not canonical labels

wave1_tm_pair_signal_expansion.role: partial Foldseek/TM pair retention signal and limitations

environment_probe.disk_floor_status: below_requested_10_gib_floor_before_artifact_write; no training, downloads, or tensor cache materialization performed
safe_cleanup_performed: removed two clean non-current Codex worktrees through git worktree remove
requested local snapshot thinning through tmutil
environment_probe.dependency_interpretation: Only torch is present in this prep environment. GVP-GNN and SE3/equivariant contracts are launch-gated on the compute environment providing torch_geometric/gvp or e3nn/se3-transformer equivalents; no packages were installed here.

frozen_inputs_and_readiness.heldout_denominator_policy: All 140 Wave 1 heldout rows remain in coverage denominators; unavailable rows are emitted with not_evaluable reasons.
frozen_inputs_and_readiness.minimal_encoder_ready_rule: geometry entry present, status ok, at least two resolved active-site residues, at least one role-annotated active-site residue, and at least one pairwise active-site distance
frozen_inputs_and_readiness.feature_spec_status: prepared_by_prior_automation; do not launch until active-site feature spec is explicitly frozen
frozen_inputs_and_readiness.target_granularity_gate_status: not_frozen_by_this_prep; do not launch until gate decides v1-only versus v1-plus-proposal-v2 auxiliary

forbidden_predictive_inputs: entry_id, PDB id, UniProt id, source path, or source artifact name as categorical features
target labels or child-label ids in predictive tensors
heldout-derived role vocabulary, scalers, thresholds, validation choices, or hyperparameters
global_leakage_exclusions.fit_policy: Role vocabularies, normalization statistics, calibration thresholds, and validation-based hyperparameter choices must be fit from in-distribution training folds only; heldout is read exactly once for final reporting.
global_leakage_exclusions.audit_requirement: Every row prediction must include forbidden_inputs_used, and every valid run must have forbidden_inputs_used equal to an empty list for all rows.

split_and_evaluation_contract.train_val_source: Wave 1 in-distribution partition only, 562 rows total and 544 encoder-ready minimal rows
split_and_evaluation_contract.validation_policy: For each seed, create a deterministic stratified validation fold from in-distribution rows only using label_group and OOS tier where available; never move heldout rows into validation or training.
split_and_evaluation_contract.primary_metric_scope: Parent v1 label-group readout with result-card-compatible heldout accuracy, macro F1, OOS false non-abstention rate, unavailable counts, and mean/std over five seeds.

v1_target_contract.secondary_probe_policy: cobalamin_radical_rearrangement, flavin_monooxygenase, and radical_sam_enzyme remain secondary OOD/probe rows unless a future frozen contract promotes them.

v2_auxiliary_target_contract.recommended_default: enabled with low auxiliary loss weight after target-granularity gate freezes proposal-v2 use
forbidden_claims: no ontology or fingerprint registry edit
v2_auxiliary_target_contract.loss_mask_policy: Compute v2 auxiliary loss only for rows with proposal-ready v2 assignments; mask all unresolved/review-needed candidates.

diagnostic_cells_to_report: canary or mixed-chemistry cells as review-only

active_site_geometry_baseline.diagnostic_strength: 17/17 near-orphan rows and 4/4 wrong-Foldseek-transfer rows supported in Wave 1.1 diagnostics; aggregate result-card accuracy is not standardized

shared_output_contract.checkpoint_policy: Do not commit model checkpoints by default. If checkpoints are needed for reproducibility, store under the run directory, cap each architecture at 250 MiB, and commit only summary/row artifacts after review.

architecture_contracts.purpose: Fast non-equivariant baseline over pooled active-site-local features; isolates value of the frozen feature spec before graph complexity.

primary_inputs: pooled residue type counts from active-site residues
pooled role multihot counts with role_other for unseen roles
distance-bin histograms over active-site residue pairs
pocket descriptor vector
local cofactor family and metal distance bins
coordinate quality and missingness masks
optional_inputs: node-only pooled features for 13 single-residue/no-pair rows as an ablation only

architecture_contracts.split_discipline: Train and tune only on in-distribution encoder-ready rows; heldout is final-only. Keep unavailable heldout rows in denominator.

target_heads.parent_v1: 9-way parent head for eight seed fingerprints plus out_of_scope, reported under primary-v1 result-card policy
target_heads.in_scope_calibration: binary in_scope versus out_of_scope head for abstention/OOS false non-abstention tracking
target_heads.v2_proposal_auxiliary: masked proposal-only head enabled only if target-granularity gate freezes v2 auxiliary use

ablations: v1-only heads versus v1 plus masked v2 auxiliary head
architecture_contracts.expected_runtime: 5 seeds in less than 15 minutes on CPU, or less than 5 minutes on one small GPU.
architecture_contracts.output_format: shared_output_contract with one summary JSON and one row-prediction JSONL for this architecture.

pass_fail_criterion.minimum_sanity_pass: Beats Sequence-NN 3-mer accuracy 0.156 and OOS false non-abstention rate 0.272 while using no forbidden inputs.
pass_fail_criterion.promotion_pass: Mean heldout primary macro F1 >= 0.696 or mean heldout primary accuracy >= 0.578, OOS false non-abstention <= 0.168, and no regression in coverage versus 135 encoder-ready heldout rows.
pass_fail_criterion.strong_pass: Matches or exceeds Foldseek macro F1 0.765 or accuracy 0.622 with OOS false non-abstention <= 0.087.
pass_fail_criterion.fail: Does not beat sequence-only sanity baseline, uses forbidden inputs, or improves primary accuracy only by raising OOS false non-abstention above ESM-2.

architecture_contracts.purpose: Small non-equivariant message-passing graph over active-site residues, with CA/local atom evidence when available.

primary_inputs: active-site residue nodes with residue type, role multihot, coordinate flags, and atom-count bucket
complete graph or radius graph edges among resolved active-site residues
CA distance bins and centroid/side-chain proxy distance bins
global pocket/cofactor/metal summary features concatenated after graph pooling
optional_inputs: local atom graph side channel for side-chain atoms parsed from already staged local mmCIF files
ligand/metal pseudo-nodes only when derived from local coordinate context and not source identifiers
excluded_inputs: full-protein graph outside active-site/local atom scope
mechanism prose, EC labels, expert notes, target labels, post-hoc repair flags

architecture_contracts.split_discipline: Use the same in-distribution train/val folds and heldout final-only discipline. Fit graph feature vocabularies and scalers from train folds only.

target_heads.in_scope_calibration: binary calibration head from graph pooled representation
target_heads.v2_proposal_auxiliary: masked proposal-v2 auxiliary head after target gate approval

ablations: complete active-site graph versus 12 A radius graph
CA distances only versus centroid/proxy distances
residue graph only versus residue plus local atom side channel
coordinate jitter robustness check on train/val only
v1-only heads versus v1 plus masked v2 auxiliary head
architecture_contracts.expected_runtime: 5 seeds in 30-60 minutes on one small GPU; CPU fallback may take 2-4 hours.
architecture_contracts.gpu_needs: One GPU with 4 GiB memory is sufficient if torch graph batching is implemented without heavyweight dependencies.
architecture_contracts.output_format: shared_output_contract with graph-specific hyperparameters, edge policy, and local atom feature availability.

pass_fail_criterion.minimum_sanity_pass: Beats active_site_mlp_pooled_v0 mean macro F1 by at least 0.02 or matches it with lower OOS false non-abstention.
pass_fail_criterion.promotion_pass: Meets or beats ESM-2 macro F1 0.696 and OOS false non-abstention 0.168, and supports at least 15/17 near-orphan geometry rescue rows when evaluable.
pass_fail_criterion.strong_pass: Closes at least 3/4 wrong-Foldseek-transfer diagnostic rows and matches Foldseek OOS false non-abstention <= 0.087.
pass_fail_criterion.fail: Graph complexity adds no heldout value over MLP or creates unsafe OOS non-abstentions.

architecture_contracts.purpose: Small vector-aware active-site residue model that can test whether local coordinate directions add value beyond distance bins.

primary_inputs: scalar node features from frozen v0 spec
3D CA or centroid coordinates for resolved active-site residues
relative direction vectors on active-site residue edges
distance radial features
coordinate masks and source flags
global pocket/cofactor/metal summary features after graph pooling
optional_inputs: side-chain anchor vectors when local atom side-chain anchors are available from staged coordinates
excluded_inputs: full protein backbone outside active-site residues
global fold or Foldseek scores as predictive inputs
source identifiers, mechanism prose, EC labels, expert notes, target labels

architecture_contracts.split_discipline: Same Wave 1 split, train-only scaler/vocabulary fitting, and heldout final-only reporting. Random rotations may be used as train-only augmentation if predictions are rotation-invariant at evaluation.

target_heads.v2_proposal_auxiliary: masked proposal-v2 auxiliary head, disabled if target gate rejects v2

ablations: scalar-only message passing with same topology
distance-only edge features without direction vectors
CA coordinates versus centroid fallback coordinates
v1-only heads versus v1 plus masked v2 auxiliary head
architecture_contracts.expected_runtime: 5 seeds in 45-90 minutes on one GPU for current702-scale graphs.
architecture_contracts.gpu_needs: One GPU with 6-8 GiB memory recommended. Current prep environment lacks torch_geometric/gvp; compute environment must provide the implementation or use an in-repo lightweight GVP runner.
architecture_contracts.output_format: shared_output_contract with coordinate source, vector feature policy, and rotation-consistency diagnostics.

pass_fail_criterion.minimum_sanity_pass: Matches or beats vanilla_graph_gnn_v0 with no increase in OOS false non-abstention and no rotation-consistency failures.
pass_fail_criterion.promotion_pass: Mean heldout macro F1 >= 0.696, OOS false non-abstention <= 0.168, and at least 16/17 near-orphan geometry rescue rows supported when evaluable.
pass_fail_criterion.strong_pass: Matches or exceeds Foldseek macro F1 0.765 or closes 4/4 wrong-Foldseek-transfer rows while maintaining OOS false non-abstention <= 0.087.
pass_fail_criterion.fail: Vector model underperforms scalar graph/MLP or depends on unavailable coordinates in a way that drops below 135/140 heldout coverage.

architecture_contracts.purpose: Small SE(3)/equivariant local-structure model only if the compute environment already has e3nn, se3-transformer, or an equivalent lightweight equivariant stack.

primary_inputs: active-site residue coordinates and scalar features
relative position vectors and radial basis distances
coordinate masks
global pocket/cofactor/metal summaries after equivariant pooling
optional_inputs: type-1 vector features from CA-to-centroid or CA-to-side-chain anchor when available
excluded_inputs: Foldseek or TM scores as predictive inputs
full-protein graph outside local active-site scope
source identifiers, EC/mechanism text, expert notes, labels, post-hoc flags

architecture_contracts.split_discipline: Same Wave 1 train/val/heldout discipline. Skip this architecture rather than installing large dependencies or downloading models during launch.

target_heads.v2_proposal_auxiliary: masked proposal-v2 auxiliary head if gate allows

ablations: distance-only radial model matched to vanilla graph
v1-only heads versus v1 plus masked v2 auxiliary head
architecture_contracts.expected_runtime: 5 seeds in 1-3 hours on one GPU if dependencies are already present; otherwise skip without blocking the sweep.
architecture_contracts.gpu_needs: One GPU with 8-16 GiB memory. Do not install large equivariant stacks in the prep or first compute launch unless disk is comfortably above the floor.
architecture_contracts.output_format: shared_output_contract with dependency manifest and equivariance-consistency diagnostics.

pass_fail_criterion.minimum_sanity_pass: Matches active_site_gvp_gnn_v0 or active_site_vanilla_graph_gnn_v0 within 0.02 macro F1 while preserving OOS safety.
pass_fail_criterion.promotion_pass: Beats GVP/vanilla graph by at least 0.02 macro F1 or uniquely fixes wrong-Foldseek-transfer rows without raising OOS false non-abstention above 0.087.
pass_fail_criterion.strong_pass: Exceeds Foldseek primary macro F1 0.765 with OOS false non-abstention <= 0.087 and no equivariance-consistency failures.
pass_fail_criterion.fail: Requires dependency installation, has unstable equivariance checks, or underperforms cheaper graph baselines.

architecture_contracts.purpose: Leakage-audited sequence/window-only control to separate active-site-local structural gains from residue sequence context.

primary_inputs: amino acid sequence tokens only
whole-sequence k-mer or compact trainable sequence encoder features
known active-site +/-64 residue windows as a controlled ablation only
window coverage and unavailable masks
optional_inputs: merged active-site windows from allowed residue positions with overlap merging
excluded_inputs: ESM-2 embeddings recomputation unless explicitly comparing to existing ESM-2 track
structure, coordinate, Foldseek, or geometry features

architecture_contracts.split_discipline: Use identical Wave 1 train/val/heldout rows. Whole-sequence mode is the fair primary comparator; active-site window mode is reported as known_active_site_window_ablation, not as a primary evidence-budget peer to whole-sequence PLM tracks.

target_heads.v2_proposal_auxiliary: masked proposal-v2 auxiliary head only if target gate allows

ablations: whole-sequence k-mer/logistic or tiny CNN baseline
active-site residue multiset with order removed
v1-only heads versus v1 plus masked v2 auxiliary head
architecture_contracts.expected_runtime: 5 seeds in 10-30 minutes on CPU; GPU optional for a tiny CNN.
architecture_contracts.output_format: shared_output_contract with pooling_mode set to whole_sequence or known_active_site_window_ablation.

pass_fail_criterion.minimum_sanity_pass: Beats existing Sequence-NN 3-mer accuracy 0.156 or lowers OOS false non-abstention below 0.272 while using sequence-only inputs.
pass_fail_criterion.promotion_pass: If whole-sequence mode approaches ESM-2 macro F1 0.696, retain as a cheap baseline. Window mode must not be compared as equal evidence budget to whole-sequence ESM-2.
pass_fail_criterion.strong_pass: Matches ESM-2 accuracy 0.578 and OOS false non-abstention <= 0.168 without pretrained embeddings.
pass_fail_criterion.fail: Window mode appears strong only because active-site annotations leak target granularity or because heldout was used for token/vocab tuning.

runner supports this contract schema and refuses forbidden predictive fields
all source artifact SHA-256 values match this prep artifact or a new prep artifact is written

do_not_launch_now: Do not start training in this prep run.
Do not materialize tensor caches while disk is below 10 GiB.
Do not install torch_geometric, gvp, e3nn, se3-transformer, or other large dependencies in this prep run.
Do not change labels, registries, ontologies, thresholds, production scoring, imports, or existing model outputs.
